Safety prerequisites
Disconnect mains power and follow lockout/tagout before removing covers. Qualified service personnel only.

--- PAGE 2 ---
Section ERR-101 Flow Sensor Fault
For GE Healthcare TestMonitor model TM-100, error ERR-101 indicates the flow sensor signal is outside expected range. First check tubing connection and cable seating. Replace flow sensor assembly PN FS-100 only after voltage measurement fails.
Required tools: calibrated DMM, manufacturer service fixture.
Table 2-1 lists expected sensor supply voltage.

Section Firmware note
Revision B applies to software 2.x. For software 1.x consult Revision A.
